outcome: Maternal complications (anemia requiring blood transfusion, postpartum sepsis, disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), maternal death)
Perinatal outcomes (birth weight, APGAR score, NICU admission, perinatal morbidity, perinatal mortality)
Fetal outcomes (intrauterine fetal deaths, still birth)
cohort: Pregnant women admitted with vaginal bleeding and diagnosed with abruptio placenta at Government General Hospital, Ananthapuramu.
finding: The study found a prevalence of abruptio placenta at 4.6%, with high rates of intrauterine fetal deaths (62%), neonatal deaths (14%), and significant maternal complications such as postpartum sepsis (59%) and anemia requiring transfusion (28%).
